home.badge: A calmer digital companion for student life
home.heroTitle1: You don't have to carry it
home.heroSubtitle: UNPACK helps university students turn everything buzzing in their mind into a clearer, lighter next step. Less mental weight, more breathing room.
home.howItWorksTitle: Unpacking your mind in four easy breaths.
home.howItWorksDesc: No complicated productivity frameworks. Pax sits beside you and helps guide the clutter into clarity.
home.step1Desc: Put everything on your mind into one place. Bullet points, half-sentences, panic notes. No formatting, no filters.
home.step1Pax: Pax sits on the notebook ready to catch it all.
home.step2Desc: UNPACK sorts the clutter into clear baggage cards by urgency, energy needed, and whether it even belongs to you.
home.step3Desc: Choose one single 10-minute micro-action to break the paralysis. Not the whole 2,000-word essay, just the outline title.
home.step3Pax: Pax hands you a single glowing pencil.
home.step4Desc: Mark it done, earn a gentle badge token, and physically watch the backpack on screen lose weight and breathe.
home.step4Pax: Pax floats happily with warm star sparkles.
home.sandboxTitle: Drop one heavy thought right here.
home.sandboxDesc: Type whatever is sitting in the back of your neck right now. We won't save it to a database until you want to.
home.sandboxPlaceholder: e.g. My neuroscience lab report is due tomorrow and I still haven't run the script...
home.sandboxSample: Need to study for chem midterms, finish group deck, and get more sleep...
home.paxFeedbackBody: "Breathe. Don't worry about the entire report right now. Your only 10-minute micro-step: Open the file and write the title heading. That's all for now."
home.closingTitle: Ready to put down what you've been carrying?
home.closingDesc: Take five quiet minutes right now. Empty the mental backpack onto the table and let's see what is actually worth picking back up.
home.footerTag: Always calm • Never algorithmic • Made with care for university students
unpack.mainHeading: What's taking up space in your mind right now?
unpack.mainSubheading: Dump it all out. Don't worry about spelling, punctuation, or organizing it. Pax will sift through the noise and help sort the weight.
unpack.placeholder: Dump everything here... exams, late laundry, messy texts, unread emails...
unpack.defaultInput: Tomorrow I have a presentation and I haven't finished my slides. My algorithm assignment is also due soon, my group hasn't replied, and I have a meeting tonight. I'm really tired and I don't know where to even begin…
unpack.paxCardDesc: I'm here to listen, no judgement.
